api:
Sim:
- OV.BUnits.fromSoldier(B, s, loadout, opts): when opts.autoLoad is not false, each firearm in a hand now starts loaded with the first compatible clip from the belt, then from the pack (the same choice as autoLoad and InventoryUI.model.loadPlan). That clip is taken out before slot capacity is checked, so it takes no belt space. With autoLoad:false nothing changes.
- OV.Combat.killUnit now sets u.deathSide = B.side || null, next to deathTurn.

OV.BattleUI:
- model gains ufoHintDue(B, contactTurn) -> bool. True only when: it is the X-COM turn and B.ufo is set; the mission is 'crash' or 'landed' and B.mission.night; B.turn - contactTurn >= UFO_HINT_TURNS (5); at least one alien is alive and every live alien is inside the B.ufo rectangle.
- model gains UFO_HINT_TURNS (5).
- debug.state() gains contactTurn and ufoHinted. New debug.contact(turn) for QA.
- openReport(kind, list, titleKey?) takes an optional title key (internal).

OV.GeoUI.model:
- nightAt(G, ref) also returns safe: true when the UFO is landed, G.month < TUNE.NIGHT_LANDING_MONTHS, and groundLeftS >= h*3600.
- waitIsDefault(G, ref, nt, craft?) is also true when nt.safe (the fuel and expiring-wreckage rules still come first).
- crewEstimate(G, ref) returns {min:n, max:n} from obj.garrison.crew.length for a site already visited.
- textKeys() includes geo.ev.arrived.night.safe.

OV.CampaignUI: briefing warnings and the briefing crew card use OV.Battle.crewRange(mission).
OV.Screens: the Quick Battle briefing uses OV.Battle.crewRange(mission).
Equip rule: CampaignUI.autoKit fits, CampaignUI.loadAmmo, and Screens.loadoutFor night flare and spareClip check fitsSlot against InventoryUI.model.visibleIn(lo, slot), so the clip inside the weapon takes no belt space.
Options scene (Esc) during a battle: footer button .scr-opt-abort «Abortar missão» (aria-keyshortcuts X, tooltip with X); the X key also works in the panel. Both close the panel and call OV.BattleUI.abort().

New pt-PT keys:
- hud.path.noShot
- hud.report.show.aria ('{btn}: {what}')
- hud.hint.title, hud.hint.ufoInside ({n})
- hud.chip.heavy, hud.tip.heavy ({w},{str},{tu},{base})
- geo.ev.arrived.night.safe ({t})

CSS:
- campaign.css: @media (max-height:640px) compacts .cp-eq header and footer, with a one-line hint. @media (orientation:portrait) and (max-width:900px) sets .cp-eq height:100%.
- ufopaedia.css: the same portrait query sets .up-panel height:100%.
- battle.css: .bs-chip.heavy.
summary:
All 10 listed items are done, plus the optional overweight indicator. Everything I ran is green:
- `node tools/test.js --strict --i18n`: 738 passed, 0 failed (58 files). The «nao.existe.x» line it prints is the existing probe for missing keys, not a real missing key.
- All 16 required QA scripts exit 0, plus ufopaedia_check, integration_r1, integration_r2 and my new integration_r3 (30/30).
- `qa/full_campaign.mjs` exits 0: one battle played, no confusing moments. The night-dialog problem several fixers reported is gone, so I did not redo the shell fixer's fix.
- Campaign bot: 4 seeds on Veterano over 150 days runs cleanly. A 2-seed `--det --save-mid` run exits 0.

I looked at the screenshots of every changed screen, in `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/ui4/integration_r3/`: path label, Esc options with the abort button and its tooltip, abort confirmation, the night UFO hint, the overweight chip, the night-safe popup, the briefing with the real garrison, Equip at 1024×560, Equip and Ufopédia on iPad portrait, and Ufopédia on iPad landscape.

Per item:
1. **Done — clip inside the weapon takes no belt space in combat.** I applied the battle fixer's `bunits.js` patch exactly as written. The `ui_persona_r3` PRELOAD probe is now a hard check (`t.ok(PRELOAD)`), so combat must match the Equip screen exactly. The determinism tests stay green; no test pins hash values. Campaign Auto-equip, «loadAmmo» and the Quick Battle kits (night flare, spare clip) now use the same rule. Visible effect: the month-1 Quick Battle night kit keeps both grenades on the belt instead of pushing one to the backpack.
2. **Done.** `killUnit` records which side was playing when a unit died. A Node test kills one soldier during the alien turn: the debrief marks it as reaction fire and the other death as a plain shot.
3. **Done.** The Esc Options panel shows a red «Abortar missão» button only during a battle. Its tooltip shows X, and X works inside the panel too. Both close the panel and open the usual abort confirmation; Cancel keeps the battle going. Checked in the browser, including that the button is absent outside a battle.
4. **Done.** The campaign briefing (warnings and crew card), the Quick Battle briefing and the Geoscape estimate use the real garrison on a revisited site. Checked in the browser: the briefing reads «1 alienígena».
5. **Done.** The new text says «nestes primeiros meses, um OVNI que aterra de noite fica no chão até amanhecer». It shows only when the UFO really is still on the ground at dawn: landed, months 0–1, and enough time left on the ground. A UFO that landed by day and takes off before dawn does not get the promise. In that safe case «Esperar pelo dia» is also the Enter default, even on Veterano after the first night attempt; the fuel and expiring-wreckage rules still win.
6. **Done.** A ○ destination reads «… · sem UT para disparar».
7. **Done.** Each log «Mostrar» / «Atacante» button's screen-reader label is the button name plus the entry text.
8. **Done.** After 5 turns with no contact on a night crash or landed UFO, the turn report shows a «Conselho»: «Sem contacto há 5 turnos: os alienígenas estão dentro do OVNI — procurem a porta e entrem juntos.» It shows once per battle. I added one condition: every live alien must actually be inside the UFO, so the text is always true. It gets its own section when other turn-report rows are present, and «Mostrar» centres on the UFO only if that area has been seen.
9. **Done.** Both CSS patches applied and checked at both sizes:
   - At 1024×560 Equip's header plus footer take 112 + 84 px, and hands and belt are visible on opening.
   - On iPad portrait (834×1194) the Equip and Ufopédia panels are 1174 px tall (the viewport is 1194); landscape is unchanged.
10. **Done.** `docs/DATA_API.md` now documents `soldierNamesTaken`, the `taken` argument of `soldierName`, `dep_alien_base.artefacts`, and the month argument of `deploymentRange`.

Optional item from the screens fixer, also done: an overweight soldier gets a «⚖ Carga» chip on the battle card. Its tooltip gives the weight, the Força and the turn TU against the normal TU, using the engine's own calculation.

Regression checks: new `tools/tests/integration_r3.test.js` (12 tests, about 0.1 s) and new `qa/integration_r3.mjs` (30 browser checks).
deviations: UFO hint (item 8): besides 'about 5 night turns without contact', I also require every live alien to be inside the UFO rectangle, so the message is never false. 'Contact' means any of: an alien sighted by X-COM, an alien visible at the start of the X-COM turn, or an alien-turn report row about our soldiers.

Night-safe text (item 5): the text and the Enter default apply only when the UFO is landed, the month is below NIGHT_LANDING_MONTHS, AND its remaining groundLeftS covers the hours until dawn. A month check alone would promise too much for a UFO that landed by day and lifts off before dawn. When it applies, «Esperar pelo dia» is the Enter default on every difficulty.
Abort in Options (item 3): besides the button, X inside the Esc panel also aborts, so the X shown in the tooltip works there.
Overweight chip: the screens fixer marked this optional. I added it as a small chip on the battle card rather than changing the TU bar.

Test and QA updates needed by the new belt rule:
- shell_persona_r1 night-flare test now measures belt capacity with visibleIn.
- inventory_check keyboard step falls back to the belt when the backpack is empty; nothing overflows into it any more.
- ui_persona_r3 now asserts PRELOAD.

qa/integration_r1.mjs was already failing before my changes, after the shell fixer's round-3 change: in Recruta the night popup's attack button is labelled «Atacar já», and the script looked for «Iniciar». The locator now accepts either.

Campaign bot (tools/campaign_bot.js) and the sim's Campaign.defaultLoadouts still check fitsSlot on the raw belt list. That is conservative (they never overfill) and I left it alone so the bot's sweeps and determinism stay comparable.
